meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调用蛋白质语言模型预测蛋白结构、生成序列,跑折叠与推理任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做蛋白质计算研究,需要用 ESM 模型跑推理与折叠
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and generate sequences with protein language models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run protein-model inference and folding in research

howto.what: Claude 会按 esm Python SDK 的写法帮你写代码并执行:用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白序列、做功能条件生成,用 ESM C 算嵌入向量,做结构预测与反向折叠,也能走 Forge/Biohub 客户端批量推理。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 `esm` Python SDK、提到 ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID,或涉及 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等场景时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 补全这条 MPRT___KEND 序列,把结果打印出来
say.note: 本地加载权重后生成补全序列

say.text: 用 esmc_300m 算这条序列的嵌入向量并返回
把 target_structure.pdb 反向折叠成序列,温度设 0.7

howto.what_en: Claude writes and runs esm Python SDK code: ESM3 for sequence generation and completion, ESMC for embeddings, structure prediction and inverse folding, plus Forge/Biohub batch inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, or Forge/Biohub inference clients and ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete the masked sequence MPRT___KEND with esm3-open and print it
say_en.note: Loads local weights, generates a completion

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for this sequence with esmc_300m
Inverse fold target_structure.pdb into a sequence, temperature 0.7
say_en.note: Designs a sequence for that structure
